ariaAttributes.description: Standard HTML aria attributes. Accepts all standard HTML aria attributes.

as.description: The HTML tag to render the container as. Defaults to `div`.

autoWidth.description: Whether to allow the container to take the width of the content. Defaults to 100%

className.description: The class name for the container. This allows you to target the container with CSS.

dataAttributes.description: Standard HTML data attributes. Accepts anything in a {{"data-key":"value"}} format.

name.description: The name of the container. This allows you to name your container query, but it's not necessary.
